description: Statutory edges: the mental health court branch under Gov't Code ch. 125 rather than the veterans branch under ch. 124; the one-expunction-per-GROUND edge, where a prior expunction exists on a different ground and none on this one; and the fee-waiver branch, which on this track is itself contested because two statutes forbid or waive any charge. Court identity and protected fields stay blank.
syntheticDataNote: All values are obviously synthetic and are never drawn from any evidence file. Names are SAMPLE/EXAMPLE strings, the county is EXAMPLE, addresses are 000-prefixed, and every date is a round synthetic value. Dates here are participant screening answers, not sourced facts; no date in this fixture is asserted by any source.

caseData.courtLevel: district court (art. 55A.203 is limited to district courts)

chargeData.disposition: Dismissed following successful completion of the programme — the participant's own account

screeningAnswers.caseNumberAndCourt: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN ANSWER — CONFIRMED AGAINST THE CLERK'S FILE]
screeningAnswers.agencyList: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN LIST — BUILT FROM THE DISTRICT CLERK'S ART. 55A.253(c) PUBLISHED LIST]
screeningAnswers.privateEntities: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN LIST — LISTED SEPARATELY, NEVER MERGED INTO THE AGENCY LIST]
screeningAnswers.specialtyProgramType: mental health court programme under Government Code Chapter 125
screeningAnswers.priorSpecialtyExpunction: yes — but on the OTHER ground; none on this ground
screeningAnswers.prosecutorConsentSought: asked; no answer yet — LegalEase does not ask and cannot obtain consent

protectedFieldsNote: Article 55A.253(a) requires the petition to carry sex, race, date of birth, driver's licence number, social security number and the address at the time of arrest, and the TRN must appear on the order under art. 55A.301. All of them are blank here and are never prefilled by any pipeline stage. How the largest counties handle sensitive data in a public civil expunction filing is a recorded release blocker; the participant supplies these by hand.
outsidePartyFieldsNote: Blank and never prefilled. The matter is a new civil action and receives a NEW cause number on filing, so no cause number can exist beforehand. The court sets the hearing not earlier than the 30th day after filing and the clerk serves under art. 55A.254; the participant does not serve. No position of the attorney representing the state, no service completion and no hearing outcome is ever stated.
attachments: Affidavit attesting to one expunction per ground (participant executes)
boundaryUnderTest: Programme edge: the route reaches exactly two programme types — veterans treatment court under Gov't Code ch. 124 and mental health court under ch. 125. This fixture takes the ch. 125 branch. Any other programme is excluded.

One-per-ground edge: the exclusion is a second expunction on THE SAME specialty-court ground. A prior expunction on a different ground does not close this one, and the affidavit attests to the fact rather than to the absence of any prior expunction at all.

Window edge: the order may be entered not later than the 30th day after the dismissal or after the court receives the dismissal information. Missing the window closes the streamlined route and sends the participant to the ordinary art. 55A.053 petition.
Court edge: district courts only. The art. 55A.252 justice-court and municipal-court-of-record alternative available on the sibling fine-only tracks is NOT available here.

Fee edge: two independent no-cost provisions, art. 55A.203(c) and art. 102.0061(d), yet a conditional Rule 145 fee-waiver component is still listed in the packet set. That conflict is carried as a build blocker.
Consent edge: unanswered. It is never asserted in either direction and is not a value this fixture sets.
